title: Nonconforming Finite Element Approximation and Energy Lower Bound Estimation for the Gross--Pitaevskii Energy Functional
summary: The ground state of Bose--Einstein condensates can be described as the minimizer of the Gross--Pitaevskii energy functional subject to a mass conservation constraint. In this paper, we study the corresponding discrete optimization problem in nonconforming finite element spaces and establish a priori error estimates for the discrete ground state energy, the discrete eigenvalue, and the discrete ground state.
